newsitem.title: CHINA: China in engine deal with Japan, Malaysia firms.
newsitem.headline: China in engine deal with Japan, Malaysia firms.

text.p: China signed an agreement for a water-cooled diesel engine project with Japan's Mitsubishi Corp, Mitsubishi Motors Corp and Malaysia's MCIC Holdings, the companies said on Monday.
A joint statement said the Shanxi Diesel Engine Factory had signed a agreement in principle with the Japanese and Malaysian firms.
It gave no value for the project or any further details.
The Japanese and Malaysian companies said they also signed initial pacts with several Chinese companies to set up engine joint ventures, company statements said.
Harbin Dong'an Engine Manufacturing Co and Harbin Aircraft Manufacturing Corp would be partners in the Harbin Dong'an Mitsubishi Engine Corp, the statement said.
China Space Automotive Industry Group Corp and Shenyang Construction Investment Co would join in the Shenyang Aerospace Mitsubishi Engine Corp, it said.
The statement did not say how much investment in the two joint ventures would be.
The pacts were some of several deals signed during the current visit to China by a major Malaysian trade delegation.
